title: NewtonSceneAPI (fallbacks read by the PhysX parser)
summary: Newton scene settings the PhysX parser reads as fallbacks on every PhysicsScene: the step rate when physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond is absent, and a switch that turns gravity off.
producer_scope: Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the ovphysx Newton schema notes).

columns.name: newton:timeStepsPerSecond
columns.absent: The scene keeps physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond, else 60. Consulted only when physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond is absent; values are clamped to [1, UINT_MAX].
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). NewtonSceneAPI declares it; the parser reads it on every PhysicsScene without checking usd-schemas.

columns.name: newton:gravityEnabled
columns.absent: Gravity as configured. A present false zeroes the gravity magnitude, whatever physics:gravityMagnitude says.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). NewtonSceneAPI declares it; read on every PhysicsScene without checking usd-schemas.

notes: newton:gravityEnabled (NewtonSceneAPI family, read on this prim by attribute name, no schema gate): when the column is present and false, physics:gravityMagnitude is forced to 0. Unconditional: an authored physics:gravityMagnitude does not suppress it, and on ovstage presence of the column is the whole gate because every column reads as authored. Absent: gravity applies.

newton:timeStepsPerSecond: fallback for physxScene:timeStepsPerSecond, applied only when the PhysX column is absent or out of range (an in-range PhysX value wins). Clamped to [1, UINT_MAX]. On a producer-populated stage with PhysxSceneAPI applied the published 60 counts as authored, so the fallback is unreachable there.

The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonSceneAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonSceneAPI makes the cache bypass.
